description: This file defines a class EmbeddingManager that manages interactions with OpenAI's embedding API, including methods for embedding single texts and batching multiple texts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the EmbeddingManager with API key, model, and batch size settings.

methods.name: embed_text
methods.description: Embeds a single text string into a vector using OpenAI API.

methods.name: batch_embed
methods.description: Embeds multiple texts in batches, returning a list of embedding vectors.
